proof_body:
by
  intro n
  simp only [card_derangements_fin_eq_numDerangements]
  suffices h : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose k : ℤ) * (numDerangements k : ℤ)) = n.factorial by exact_mod_cast h
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Nat.factorial_succ]
    have h1 : ∀ k, ((n + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℤ) * (numDerangements (k + 1) : ℤ) = (n + 1) * ((n.choose k : ℤ) * (numDerangements k : ℤ)) + ((n + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℤ) * (-1) ^ (k + 1) := by
      intro k
      have h2 : ((n + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℤ) * (k + 1) = (n + 1) * (n.choose k : ℤ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq n k).symm
      rw [numDerangements_succ]
      linear_combination (numDerangements k : ℤ) * h2
    simp only [h1]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ih]
    have h3 : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℤ) * (-1) ^ (k + 1)) + 1 = 0 := by
      have := Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_of_ne (n := n + 1) (by omega)
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at this
      simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one] at this
      calc _ = _ := ?_
           _ = 0 := this
      refine congrArg (· + 1) (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_)
      simp [mul_comm]
    simp
    linear_combination h3
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose k * Fintype.card (derangements (Fin k)) = n.factorial
